sentences.text: In Delhi, the overall workplace exposure risk today is EXTREME.
There is no safe continuous window today; consider rescheduling shift hours.
Hydration guideline: about 250 ml every 15-20 minutes during frequent windows; otherwise drink normally
High air pollution requires wearing an N95/FFP2 mask during outdoor duties.

seek_help: Stop work, move to shade, and call emergency services if you experience confusion, fainting, or stop sweating.
